promise: By June, we will compile a roadmap to realize the new form of capitalism
description: In his January 2023 policy speech to the Diet, Kishida promised a concrete roadmap for his flagship 'new capitalism' (shin shihonshugi) policy by June 2023. The Cabinet approved the roughly 200-measure roadmap on June 16, 2023, covering wage growth, investment in people, and science/tech priorities, meeting the deadline he set.
evidence: Cabinet approved the 'New Form of Capitalism' roadmap on June 16, 2023
Roadmap included ~200 measures on wages, human capital investment, and innovation

promise: We are working toward closing [the Activision Blizzard deal] in fiscal year 2023
description: Microsoft's 10-Q filed Jan 24, 2023 stated the $68.7B Activision Blizzard acquisition would close within fiscal year 2023 (by June 30, 2023). Regulatory fights with the UK CMA and FTC forced the deal to miss that deadline and it finally closed October 13, 2023 — about 3.5 months late, after the companies extended the contractual deadline to October 18, 2023.
evidence: 10-Q verbatim: 'We are continuing to engage with regulators reviewing the transaction and are working toward closing it in fiscal year 2023'
Original contract deadline was July 18, 2023, extended to Oct 18, 2023
Deal completed October 13, 2023 at total cost of $75.4 billion
Missed the promised fiscal 2023 close date by ~3.5 months

promise: X will be cash-flow positive by the second quarter of 2023
description: At a Morgan Stanley conference in March 2023 Musk said Twitter could become cash-flow positive 'next quarter', and in April he said the company could reach it 'as soon as this quarter'. In July 2023 he admitted cash flow was still negative because of a nearly 50% drop in advertising revenue and heavy debt load.
evidence: Musk admitted in July 2023 that Twitter/X cash flow remained negative
Ad revenue fell ~50% in 2023; X later wrote down value sharply
